payload.content: This database uses SQLite. Use SQLite-only date/time syntax: STRFTIME('%Y', date_column) for year extraction; STRFTIME('%Y', date('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', birth_date) for age in years; date('now') for the current date. NEVER use PostgreSQL idioms (DATE_PART, AGE(), EXTRACT, NOW(), CURDATE(), TIMESTAMPDIFF) — they will fail.

rationale: Targets bird q_asks_temporal=yes failures (76% fail rate). Pattern: model emits PostgreSQL-flavored DATE_PART/AGE/TIMESTAMPDIFF idioms instead of SQLite STRFTIME. Predicate (analysis-time slice): regex on question matching '\b(age|years? old|older than|younger than|born in|since|before|after \d{4})\b' or schema has DATE columns.
